import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm

class LegacyModel:
    def __init__(self):
        self.coef_ = None

    def fit(self, frame: pd.DataFrame, train_rows: np.ndarray | None = None) -> "LegacyModel":
        # Filter the frame based on train_rows
        if train_rows is not None:
            frame = frame[frame[".row"].isin(train_rows)]

        # QUIRK: Ensure exposure > 0
        frame = frame[frame["exposure"] > 0]

        # Convert categorical variables to category dtype
        frame["veh_age"] = frame["veh_age"].astype("category")
        frame["agecat"] = frame["agecat"].astype("category")

        # Prepare the design matrix
        X = pd.get_dummies(frame["veh_body"], prefix="veh_body", drop_first=True)
        X = pd.concat([X, pd.get_dummies(frame["veh_age"], prefix="veh_age", drop_first=True)], axis=1)
        X = pd.concat([X, pd.get_dummies(frame["agecat"], prefix="agecat", drop_first=True)], axis=1)
        X = pd.concat([X, pd.get_dummies(frame["area"], prefix="area", drop_first=True)], axis=1)
        X = pd.concat([X, pd.get_dummies(frame["gender"], prefix="gender", drop_first=True)], axis=1)

        # Add intercept
        X = sm.add_constant(X, has_constant="add")

        # Fit the GLM model
        y = frame["numclaims"]
        offset = np.log(frame["exposure"])
        model = sm.GLM(y, X, family=sm.families.Poisson(link=sm.families.links.log()), offset=offset)
        fit = model.fit(tol=1e-12, maxiter=100)

        # Store coefficients
        self.coef_ = fit.params

        return self

    def score(self, frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        # Prepare the design matrix for scoring
        X = pd.get_dummies(frame["veh_body"], prefix="veh_body", drop_first=True)
        X = pd.concat([X, pd.get_dummies(frame["veh_age"], prefix="veh_age", drop_first=True)], axis=1)
        X = pd.concat([X, pd.get_dummies(frame["agecat"], prefix="agecat", drop_first=True)], axis=1)
        X = pd.concat([X, pd.get_dummies(frame["area"], prefix="area", drop_first=True)], axis=1)
        X = pd.concat([X, pd.get_dummies(frame["gender"], prefix="gender", drop_first=True)], axis=1)

        # Add intercept
        X = sm.add_constant(X, has_constant="add")

        # QUIRK: Handle unseen levels by filling with zeros
        for col in self.coef_.index:
            if col not in X.columns:
                X[col] = 0

        # Calculate linear predictor
        eta = np.dot(X, self.coef_)
        # Calculate predicted frequency
        freq_hat = np.exp(eta.astype(float))  # Ensure eta is float

        # Prepare the output DataFrame
        output = pd.DataFrame(index=frame.index)
        output["score"] = freq_hat / frame["exposure"]

        return output

    @property
    def coef(self) -> pd.Series | None:
        return self.coef_ if self.coef_ is not None else None
